_comment: C0-15 localai bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（ollama/vllm），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk, llamaindex]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: A multi-engine architecture connecting various backends; official-site stance "Run text, voice, vision, image, video, 3D and agent workloads through one open runtime" (direct-fetched); the model/engine matrix not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: A single binary: an OpenAI-compatible API fronting multiple backends; the site also claims Anthropic/Ollama/ElevenLabs API compatibility (direct-fetched); GitHub 50,065★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Official-site stance "keep your data on your hardware" (direct-fetched); fully self-hosted.
axes.background: A resident-service form (single-binary API server); CPU-only mode is named on the official site (direct-fetched); concurrency details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: Agent workloads sit inside the official multimodal narrative; the tool-calling surface and MCP support not verified item by item.
axes.context: Context length varies by backend engine and deployment configuration; cross-request caching and memory lines not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Self-hosted with no account system; API authentication configured by the deploying party; the credential surface of multi-engine backends (e.g. connecting cloud APIs) not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: switching existing OpenAI clients to local by just changing a URL with one binary; wanting text-plus (voice/image) multimodal workloads on one runtime. Does not fit: single-LLM maximum performance (dedicated engines are sharper); wanting big-institution backing (an individual-led project).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The full engines matrix and each engine's model-support surface (not inventoried item by item)
- The completeness of the Anthropic/ElevenLabs compatibility surfaces (official-site claims direct-fetched; details not verified item by item)
- MCP support status (not verified item by item)
related: Both OpenAI-compatible local stacks: Ollama's model library is smoother out of the box, LocalAI is broader on multimodal and multi-API compatibility.
vLLM is sharper on single-LLM service throughput; LocalAI's value is "one runtime, many workloads".
